replacement: “I’ve known about it for a long time. I telegraphed to Moscow to inquire, and heard long ago that the money had not come. He hadn’t sent it, but I said nothing. Last week I found out that he was still short of money. All I wanted in all this was for him to know whom to turn to, and who was his true friend. No, he won’t admit that I am his truest friend. He won’t know me. He looks on me only as a woman. I’ve been tormented all week, trying to think how to keep him from being ashamed to face me because he spent that three thousand. Let him be ashamed of himself, let him be ashamed of other people knowing, but not of my knowing. He can tell God everything without shame. Why is it that he still doesn’t understand how much I’m ready to bear for his sake? Why, why doesn’t he know me? How dare he not know me, after all that has happened? I want to save him forever. Let him forget me as his betrothed. And here he fears that he’s dishonored in my eyes. Why, he wasn’t afraid to be open with you, Alexey Fyodorovitch. Why do I not deserve the same?”

And he told her the whole scene: how Dmitri had sent him to get the money, how Dmitri had burst in and knocked his father down, and how after that Dmitri had again, specially and emphatically, begged Alyosha to carry her his compliments and his farewell. “He has gone to that woman,” Alyosha added softly.

“Yes, and maybe you misunderstand me completely too, dear young lady. Maybe I’m not as good as I seem to you. I have a bad heart. I will have my own way. I charmed poor Dmitri Fyodorovitch that day just for fun.”
